test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Ministry of Labour and Employment has developed eSHRAM portal for ________.

options.text: creating a National Database of Public Sector Undertakings Workers (NDPSUW)
creating a National Database of Government Workers (NDGW)
creating a National Database of Organised Workers (NDOW)
creating a National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW)

solution:
The correct answer is __**creating a National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **e-SHRAM** portal is inaugurated on** 26th August 2021** by **Shri Bhupendar Yadav, Hon'ble Minister (L&E) **in presence of** Shri Rameswar Teli, Hon'ble Minister of states (L&E).**
 
• **eSHRAM portal** has been developed for creating a **national Database of Unorganised Workers, which is seeded with Aadhaar**.
 
• It will have details of the **name, Occupation, Address, Educational qualification, Skill types, Family details, etc**.
 
• For the optimum realization of their employability and to extend the benefits of the** social security** schemes to them. 
 
• Any worker who is working in an **unorganized sector** and aged between **16-59**, is **eligible to register on the eSHRAM portal **e.g. **migrant workers, gig workers, platform workers, agricultural workers, MGNREGA workers, fishermen, Milkmen, ASHA workers, Anganwadi workers, Street vendors, Domestic workers, Rickshaw pullers **and other workers engaged in similar other occupations in the Unorganised sectors.
 
• It is the **1st ever national database of unorganized workers** including migrant workers, construction workers, etc.
